source_evidence: Smaller or emerging companies may also have to issue high-yield bonds to offset unproven operating histories
question: Misconception: Only companies in financial distress issue high-yield bonds.
answer: Correction: Financial difficulties are one possible characteristic of high-yield bond issuers, but they are not the only one. Smaller or emerging companies may also issue these bonds because they have unproven operating histories or because their financial plans are considered speculative or risky.
